copias_seguridad.estado.compatible: The declared versions are compatible. Authenticity and an isolated restore still need to be verified.
copias_seguridad.estado.incompatible: The declared versions are incompatible. Resolve the differences before preparing a restore.
copias_seguridad.estado.no_comprobable: Compatibility cannot be checked. Complete or correct the inventory.
copias_seguridad.error.entrada: The comparison could not be read. Check the format and required fields.
copias_seguridad.error.argumentos: Invalid arguments. Use -catalogo followed by the catalogue path, or provide no arguments.
copias_seguridad.error.catalogo: The text catalogue could not be read. Check the file and its keys.
copias_seguridad.error.salida: The result could not be written. Check the output destination.
copias_seguridad.razon.dato_no_comprobab: Required information is missing or an inventory value is invalid.

copias_seguridad.razon.migracion_huella_: A migration has the same identifier but different content.
copias_seguridad.razon.esquema_huella_di: A module structure differs from the declared structure.
copias_seguridad.razon.release_diferente: The application release differs from the declared release.
copias_seguridad.razon.commit_diferente: The binary source revision differs from the declared revision.
copias_seguridad.razon.plataforma_difere: The destination platform does not match the archived set.
copias_seguridad.razon.binarios_diferent: The installed binaries differ from the declared binaries.
copias_seguridad.razon.componentes_difer: The application files differ from the declared files.
copias_seguridad.razon.postgresql_versio: The exact PostgreSQL version does not match.
copias_seguridad.razon.runtime_diferente: PostgreSQL, its tools or extensions differ from the declared set.
copias_seguridad.razon.cluster_diferente: The observed source does not match the declared source.
copias_seguridad.razon.bases_diferentes: The destination databases do not match the complete backup scope.
copias_seguridad.razon.almacenes_diferen: The stores do not match the declared stores.
copias_seguridad.razon.modo_no_admitido: This version requires the complete set, including the application.
copias_seguridad.razon.inventario_huella: The inventory does not match the digest recorded in the manifest.
copias_seguridad.razon.release_incomplet: The backup does not contain all archived release files.
copias_seguridad.razon.runtime_no_admiti: The current policy does not allow this exact PostgreSQL and tool combination.
copias_seguridad.razon.release_no_admiti: The current policy does not allow this exact application release.
copias_seguridad.razon.release_revocada: The archived release is revoked and cannot be recovered.
